title: P3 group - Cell behavior at low temperatures (white paper)
notes: White paper, 2024. LFP cathode resistance at -20 °C is about three times its room-temperature value; NCA cathodes cope better with low temperatures than LFP. Mechanism only, no range figures. B116: shape of the LFP cold penalty below -10 °C (owner decision 2026-11-20).
